reasons.detail: R1 — `presets list` now uses `listPresets(repoRoot(), ...)`, which combines core presets with project plugin registry presets before rendering.

R2 — Tree rendering remains hierarchical via parent/child links and now consumes project registry presets, enabling `base -> webapp -> js-webapp -> nextjs` chain display when official-presets are installed.
R3 — Registry lookup failures are handled in non-strict mode by `registryPresets` returning `[]`, so base preset fallback still renders; command errors only on explicit/unrecoverable exceptions.

R5 — Changes are isolated to `presets list` inventory/formatting and bounded registry loading; setup candidate/chain resolver paths and plugin install flow are not altered, and setup/package behavior is unchanged.
R4 — `formatPresetTree` preserves root/child tree rendering format, branch connectors, labels, alias and scan markers, template marker, alphabetical child sorting, and missing-base fallback behavior.

R6 — Command now caps preset input via `maxEntries=512`, enforces depth with `MAX_PRESET_TREE_DEPTH`, and tracks visited keys to avoid revisiting cycles; plugin registry changes support bounded preset loading before formatting.
